pending.why: Carried over from 2026-08-02 and still owed. Supabase was UP on both runs and every other column landed. The study object is about 23KB of minified JSON and the only write path available to the routine is the Supabase MCP execute_sql tool, which requires the whole object to be re-emitted verbatim inside the tool call. This is a connector limitation, NOT an outage, and re-emitting 23KB by hand carries a real risk of silent corruption.
